title: Manuel Perez's playing: funeral marches, regular marches and jazz on the way back
summary: Miller explains that funeral marches were played straight, marches were played from the music, and jazz numbers came on the return; Perez played melody, rather high.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
